queries_run: Coherent COHR largest customer Nvidia revenue concentration fiscal 2026 10-K
Coherent COHR customer credit downgrade OR bankruptcy OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：一家主要客戶占合併營收 20%（FY2025、FY2024 各 10%），第二大客戶占 12%；主要來自 Datacenter & Communications 部門。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 8 Major Customers
findings.excerpt: One major customer accounted for 20%, 10%, and 10% of consolidated revenue during fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively. A second major customer accounted for 12% of consolidated revenue during fiscal 2026.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：兩家客戶在 FY2026 各占營收逾 10%，預期集中度將持續。
findings.excerpt: A small number of customers have consistently accounted for a significant portion of our revenues, with two customers each contributing more than 10% of total revenues in fiscal 2026.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未找到 COHR 大客戶的信用降級、破產或客戶端財務惡化之具名報導；僅有第三方泛稱 AI 雲端業者信用壓力，非具名客戶，未列為 finding。客戶身分 10-K 未具名。
